verses.raw: Because of that, We decreed upon the Children of Israel that whoever kills a soul unless for a soul<sup foot_note=254264>1</sup> or for corruption [done] in the land<sup foot_note=254265>2</sup> - it is as if he had slain mankind entirely. And whoever saves one<sup foot_note=254266>3</sup> - it is as if he had saved mankind entirely. And Our messengers had certainly come to them with clear proofs. Then indeed many of them, [even] after that, throughout the land, were transgressors.<sup foot_note=254267>4</sup>
